analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,613,000 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (1,476,800/1,622,400/2,056,840 KRW) — trading above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20, indicating a sideways range.
· Below SMA100 (1,732,738 KRW), above SMA200 (1,223,421 KRW) — mixed mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (46.8%) + current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.6 → 46.1) — exiting oversold territory and maintaining neutral range.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-8545.8787 → 14678.3345) — confirmed improvement from bearish to bullish.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 1,622,400 KRW) — trading around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (1,246,000 KRW) — support based on 20-day low.
· Swing Resistance (1,972,368 KRW) — resistance at the upper Bollinger Band.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) — attempting recovery by making higher lows.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.66x) — subdued volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — RSI neutral, MACD improvement signals confirmed, but trading is on hold due to low volume; maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
